title: Messaging SMS Failed Event
description: An outbound SMS text could not be sent or delivered, e.g. Telnyx 40010 (sending number not 10DLC-registered). One entity per transport (messaging.<transport>.<action>), the same split as the chat platforms; carrier texts order per operator line, ordering_key line:<line>, so one conversation stays ordered when it switches SMS/MMS or falls back from RCS. Calls and voicemail stay in telephony. See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md (messaging).

ordering_key.description: Section 11.1 bucket 'line:<line>', the same value as 'line:' + data.line: every carrier text on one operator line orders together, whatever the transport.

message_id.description: Provider id, or null when the provider refused the request outright.

line.description: The operator line involved: 'cell' (the personal Verizon line, forwarded from the Android phone), 'imessage' (the operator's iMessage account on the Mac, through BlueBubbles), or the E.164 of a Telnyx number.

command_id.description: command_id of the causing messaging.sms.send, if any.
